name: Cenomi Centers (Arabian Centres Company)
note: Listed on the Saudi Exchange (Tadawul). Per the 2025 annual report: immediate parent FAS Real Estate Company Limited (26.89% of capital at 31 December 2025, the largest stake in the substantial-shareholdings table; the next holder holds 4.00%) and ultimate parent Saudi FAS Holding Company; the related-party note of its 2025 consolidated financial statements names Fawaz Abdulaziz Alhokair, Salman Abdulaziz Alhokair and Abdulmajeed Abdulaziz Alhokair as the joint ultimate controlling shareholders of the company, and its board biographies describe Fawaz Abdulaziz Al Hokair, the chairman of the board, as Chairman of both Arabian Centres Company and Saudi FAS Holding Company.
